title: Renew your surveyor registration
summary: Learn how to renew your annual registration as a land or mining surveyor in NSW.
intro:
You must renew your registration as a land or mining surveyor in NSW annually to maintain your licence.

To check your licence or registration details visit Verify NSW.
who_can_apply: Hold a current NSW surveyor registration or licence
Demonstrate meeting the Board of Surveying and Spatial Information (BOSSI) continuing professional development (CPD) requirements
what_you_need: A credit or debit card to pay the registration fee

how_to_steps.text: Follow the prompts to renew your registration.

external_links.text: NSW CPD providers for surveyors – BOSSI

internal_links.text: Apply to be a registered land or mining surveyor
Update your registered surveyor contact details

faqs.q: How often do I need to renew my surveyor registration?
faqs.a: You must renew your registration as a land or mining surveyor in NSW annually to maintain your licence.

faqs.q: Where can I check my current licence or registration details?
faqs.a: You can check your licence or registration details by visiting Verify NSW.

faqs.q: What do I need to do to be eligible to renew my registration?
faqs.a: You must hold a current NSW surveyor registration or licence and demonstrate that you have met the Board of Surveying and Spatial Information (BOSSI) continuing professional development (CPD) requirements.
